recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血抹片中散布許多中至大型異常淋巴樣細胞，核不規則、胞質嗜鹼性，大小明顯超過一般淋巴球，還有好幾顆破裂的細胞，這種易碎的大細胞群符合大細胞淋巴瘤的白血病期。
features: Increased numbers of medium to large atypical mononuclear cells scattered across the smear
Irregular, angulated nuclei with moderate amounts of basophilic cytoplasm
Few normal neutrophils; red cells show rouleaux-like stacking and drying artifact
Nuclear detail and nucleoli not resolvable at this low magnification
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows increased numbers of medium to large atypical mononuclear cells with irregular nuclei and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, accompanied by several smudged cells. Normal neutrophils are infrequent. Fine chromatin and nucleolar features cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of circulating lymphoma cells, consistent with the leukemic phase of large cell lymphoma, and should be confirmed by high-power review and flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Low power cannot separate large lymphoma cells from blasts; immunophenotyping for CD34/TdT versus mature B-cell markers is required.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia with smudge cells
ddx.vs: CLL cells are uniformly small with scant cytoplasm and clumped chromatin rather than large cells with abundant basophilic cytoplasm.
Reactive lymphocytes show a heterogeneous spectrum with abundant cytoplasm scalloping around red cells and are polyclonal on flow cytometry.
